title: 10-Day Turkey & Greek Islands Discovery Tour
metaDescription: Travel from Istanbul to Athens, Mykonos and Santorini in 10 days, blending historic capitals with the scenery and island life of the Cyclades.
breadcrumb: Explore Our Travel Destinations & Multi-Country Tours
summary:
The 10-Day Best of Turkey & Greece Trip links inland Turkey with the Aegean islands, moving from archaeological sites and distinctive landscapes to a multi-island journey in Greece. Explore Cappadocia before continuing to Pamukkale and ancient Ephesus, then cross the Aegean to Samos. From there, the Greek portion continues through Mykonos and Santorini, creating a route that combines three very different islands with Turkey’s principal cultural stops.
The itinerary can be arranged around your preferred travel dates and adjusted where possible. Selected 4-star hotels, daily breakfast, English-speaking local guides, scheduled flights, Greek ferry connections, airport transfers and planned sightseeing are included.

itinerary.title: Flight to Cappadocia
itinerary.text:
Pick up from your hotel in Istanbul and transfer to the airport for your flight to Nevsehir.
Upon arrival, meet and transfer to your hotel in Cappadocia. Check in and overnight in Cappadocia.

itinerary.title: North Cappadocia Tour
itinerary.text:
Optional: Early morning hot air balloon ride over Cappadocia.
After breakfast at 10:00, enjoy a full-day tour of North Cappadocia. Visit Uchisar Castle for panoramic views, followed by Rose Valley, Pasabag, and the Zelve Open Air Museum, famous for fairy chimneys and cave dwellings. After lunch, continue to Devrent Valley and Three Beauties, then visit the charming towns of Urgup and Avanos, known for traditional pottery. After the tour, return to the hotel. Overnight in Cappadocia.

itinerary.title: South Cappadocia tour- Flight to Izmir
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 09:00, enjoy a full-day tour of South Cappadocia. Visit Ortahisar Castle, the former Greek village of Mustafapaşa, and the Roman ruins of Sobesos Ancient City. Continue to Soğanlı Valley for a scenic walk through its cave churches, followed by lunch. After lunch, explore Kaymakli Underground City, one of Cappadocia’s most famous underground settlements. After the tour, transfer to Kayseri Airport for your flight to Izmir at 22:50. Upon arrival at 00:20, meet and transfer to Kusadasi. Overnight in Kusadasi.

itinerary.title: Tour of Ephesus and House of Virgin Mary
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 09:00, enjoy a guided tour of Ephesus, visiting highlights such as the Odeon, Library of Celsus, Temple of Hadrian, Fountain of Trajan, and the Great Theatre. Continue to the ruins of the Temple of Artemis, followed by lunch and a visit to the House of the Virgin Mary. Overnight in Kusadasi.

itinerary.title: Day trip to Pamukkale & Hierapolis
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 07:30, depart for Pamukkale to explore its famous white travertine terraces and the ancient city of Hierapolis. Guests may also enjoy swimming at the famous Cleopatra Antique Pools (optional, extra entrance fee applies). After the tour, drive back to Kusadasi. Overnight in Kusadasi.

itinerary.title: Ferry to Mykonos via Samos
itinerary.text:
Breakfast at the hotel, then transfer to Kusadasi Port for your ferry to Samos.
Enjoy free time in Samos before continuing by ferry to Mykonos.
Upon arrival, transfer to your hotel. Overnight in Mykonos.

itinerary.title: Free day in Mykonos
itinerary.text:
Breakfast at the hotel.
Enjoy a full day at leisure in Mykonos to explore Mykonos Town, relax on the beaches, and discover the island’s shops, cafés, and famous nightlife. Overnight in Mykonos.

itinerary.title: Ferry to Santorini
itinerary.text:
Breakfast at the hotel, then transfer to the port in Mykonos for your ferry to Santorini.
Upon arrival, transfer to your hotel. Free time at leisure. Overnight in Santorini.

itinerary.title: Free Day in Santorini
itinerary.text:
Breakfast at the hotel.
Enjoy a free day to explore Santorini, relax on the beaches, and visit its traditional villages.
Optional walk from Fira to Oia to enjoy the island’s famous sunset. Overnight in Santorini.

itinerary.title: Santorini to Athens
itinerary.text:
Breakfast at the hotel, then transfer to the port in Santorini for your ferry to Athens.
Flight option is available at extra cost. Upon arrival, transfer to your hotel in Athens.
End of services.

faqs.q: What destinations are included in the 10-Day Best of Turkey and Greece Trip?
faqs.a: The 10-Day Best of Turkey and Greece Trip covers Istanbul, Cappadocia, Pamukkale, Ephesus, Athens, Santorini, and Mykonos. You will explore Istanbul's historic landmarks, discover Cappadocia's fairy chimneys, visit the ancient city of Ephesus and the white travertine terraces of Pamukkale, then continue to Greece to experience Athens, the stunning island of Santorini, and the vibrant atmosphere of Mykonos. The tour runs for 9 nights and 10 days.

faqs.q: How much does the 10-Day Best of Turkey and Greece Trip cost?
faqs.a: The tour starts from 2,695 euros per person for the 2026 season. The price includes accommodation, domestic flights within Turkey, the international flight between Turkey and Greece, ferry tickets between the Greek islands, guided tours, entrance fees, selected meals, and all airport, hotel, and port transfers. Final pricing may vary depending on travel dates and hotel availability.

faqs.q: Are flights and ferry tickets included in this 10-day itinerary?
faqs.a: Yes, the package includes domestic flights within Turkey, the international flight from Turkey to Greece, and ferry transportation between Athens, Mykonos, and Santorini as outlined in the itinerary. These travel arrangements help maximize your sightseeing time while ensuring a comfortable journey.

faqs.q: What kind of accommodation does the tour provide?
faqs.a: The package includes 9 nights at carefully selected 4-star hotels and boutique accommodations with daily breakfast. Hotels are chosen for their comfort, quality, and convenient locations near major attractions, city centers, and ferry ports. All airport, hotel, and port transfers are included.

faqs.q: Does the 10-day Turkey and Greece trip include a guide?
faqs.a: Yes, professional English-speaking guides are included during the scheduled sightseeing tours in Turkey and Athens. Your guides provide historical insights, cultural context, and local expertise while ensuring a smooth and enjoyable travel experience throughout the trip.

faqs.q: Is this tour suitable for first-time visitors to Turkey and Greece?
faqs.a: Yes, this tour is ideal for first-time visitors who want to experience the most famous attractions of both countries in a shorter timeframe. It combines Turkey's historical treasures with Greece's iconic islands, creating a balanced itinerary filled with culture, history, scenery, and relaxation.

faqs.q: How fit do I need to be for the 10-day tour?
faqs.a: The physical difficulty is moderate. Travelers should be comfortable walking through archaeological sites, historic districts, and areas with uneven surfaces, including Ephesus, Pamukkale, the Acropolis, and Cappadocia. Most travelers in average health can comfortably enjoy the itinerary.

faqs.q: Can I add a hot air balloon ride in Cappadocia?
faqs.a: The Cappadocia hot air balloon ride is not included in the standard package but can be arranged as an optional activity. Since balloon flights depend on weather conditions and availability, advance reservations are strongly recommended.

faqs.q: What is the cancellation policy for the Best of Turkey and Greece Trip?
faqs.a: You can cancel free of charge up to 30 days before the tour departure date. Cancellations made within 30 days of travel may be subject to fees according to the booking terms and cancellation policy. Travel insurance is recommended for additional flexibility and peace of mind.

faqs.q: Is the 10-Day Best of Turkey and Greece Trip available all year and can it be customized?
faqs.a: The tour operates throughout the year, subject to seasonal ferry schedules, and can be customized according to your preferences. You can extend your stay in Istanbul, Mykonos, or Santorini, upgrade hotel categories, add optional excursions, or modify the itinerary. Contact Magnificent Travel for a personalized itinerary and quotation.
